06 / BEFORE YOUR TAKEDOWN

A few things
to know.

Have your service and hair condition in mind when choosing your appointment.

Who can book a takedown?

Adults and children are welcome. Choose the service that matches the hairstyle being removed.

What styles do you remove?

We offer braid, weave and cornrow takedowns. Cornrows are priced separately depending on whether extensions are included. Frontal removal is not currently offered.

What if my braids are old or tangled?

Heavily tangled or matted braid takedowns start at $120. Clear photos are required to review the condition of your hair and confirm a quote before booking. Pricing depends on the additional work needed.

Can you come to my home?

Yes. Home service is available for an additional fee based on distance. Select a home visit and provide your city or ZIP code. Your travel fee will be confirmed before booking.

How long does a takedown take?

Time varies with the style, braid size, length and tangling. Photos help us assess the work and discuss the expected appointment time.

Is a deposit required?

A $25 deposit is due at booking to secure your appointment. It goes toward your total service price. Any home visit travel fee is additional and confirmed before booking.

What is your cancellation policy?

Please notify us at least 24 hours before cancelling or rescheduling your appointment. Providing 48 hours’ notice whenever possible is appreciated. Your deposit can transfer once to a new date when you reschedule with at least 24 hours’ notice.

Do you offer refunds?

Payments, including the $25 deposit, are nonrefundable. Please review your service and appointment details before paying.

What if I have allergies to hair products?

Please list any product allergies or sensitivities on your booking form so we can discuss suitable products before your appointment.

Does the service include a wash or new hairstyle?

The service menu is for takedowns. A wash or new hairstyle is not included in the listed prices.
